missing upstream numerical objects. Q05/Q06 remain deferred at their existing
gates; there is no request to select an experiment now. This completes the
bounded paper-definition deliverable even though the numerical route remains
unavailable. Filling a form, approving a scope or reusing operator mathematics
cannot close the numerical-method gate by itself.
